newsitem.title: USA: Tribune Co Q3 net increases.
newsitem.headline: Tribune Co Q3 net increases.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q3 1995 results include discontinued operations income of $11,828,000 or $0.18 a share primary ($0.17 a share fully diluted).

Q3 1995 income from continuing operations was $0.61 a share primary and $0.56 a share fully diluted, including an after-tax loss of $4,500,000 from sale of Times Advocate Co in California. Excluding that loss, income from continuing operations was $0.68 per primary share and $0.62 per fully diluted share.
Q3 net is before preferred dividends of $4.7 million vs $4.6 million.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Nine-month 1996 results include income from discontinued operations of $89,317,000 ($1.46 per primary share, $1.31 per fully diluted share) related to sale of QUNO Corp holdings.
Nine-month 1995 results include income from discontinued operations of $25,392,000 ($0.39 per primary share, $0.35 per fully diluted share).

In March 1995, Tribune sold shares of American Online Inc, resulting in a Q1 1995 after-tax gian of $9,100,000 or $0.14/primary share. In July 1995 it sold its Times Advocate Co, resulting in a after-tax loss of $4,500,000 or $0.07/primary share. Excluding these items, continuing operations net income for 1995 nine months was $2.48/primary share, $2.29/fully diluted share.
